results.input: Job CLAIMSX12 failed with user abend U1204 in STEP0070. What validation error caused the abend, which input record was affected, and what corrective action should Production Support recommend?
results.expected: Job CLAIMSX12 failed with U1204 in STEP0070 because input record 215 in CLM.SUBMIT.BATCH was truncated to 180 bytes instead of the required 200 bytes, leaving the TRAILER-REASON field missing.
